_comment: Sprinto ICP as the Evidence Map (L4 deck) plus the Evals deck's shortlist rules (Series A-C only, soft 50-200 headcount band). Drives extraction, the loop and qualification. Edit thresholds here, not in code.

questions.label: B2B SaaS?
questions.sufficient: the description names who buys it

questions.label: Right stage?
questions.sufficient: funding stage named, OR 5+ open roles, OR enterprise pricing tier
questions.if_unanswered: qualify at lower rank, flagged (if the fetch cap stops the loop first: escalated)

questions.label: Right size?
questions.if_unanswered: no effect on the verdict; flagged 'size unknown'

ranking._comment: Stage now gates (Series A-C only); compliance pressure still lifts a qualified company to rank 'high'.

_personas_comment: Who Sprinto sells to, best first. PoC choice takes the lowest-rank persona whose keywords match the title; ties go to Hunter's confidence. No match = no contact (flagged), never 'nearest manager'.
_links_comment: Before guessing a path, the loop follows a link the company itself publishes on its homepage whose URL or text matches a question's link_keywords (e.g. its Trust center, a SOC 2 announcement, its jobs board). A 404 does not use up a question's limit; every fetch counts toward the cap.
_funding_comment: Evals deck, Decision 1: funding stage must be Series A, B or C. Seed, Series D+ and 'bootstrapped/profitable' are rejected. A funding mention older than max_age_years is stale and counts as unknown (Decision 2: recency).
_size_comment: Evals deck, Decision 1: target 50-200 employees, a SOFT band. near_low..near_high is 'moderately outside, still acceptable' (accepted, noted, flagged); beyond that is far outside and rejected. Unknown size never rejects.
